# WP1-c step 0: attack anatomy (telemetry versus ground truth)

Deviation: reported (IPAL, vantage n302) minus true (nearest physical snapshot) beyond a noise threshold (voltage 0.002, active_power 20000, reactive_power 20000, active_power_from 20000, active_power_hv 20000, is_closed 0.5, is_connected 0.5; W and var for powers), every 5th record. Snapshot timing alone produces deviations, so the same comparison is run on 12 benign control windows (300 s, at least 120 s from attacks). Listed per attack: field kinds whose deviation rate (deviating elements per compared record) is at least 3 times the benign rate (benign floor 0.05) and at least 0.2. Real changes: switch or connection states of the true grid inside the window that differ from 25 to 30 s before it.
